# Habito

> Habito is an Android habit tracker app for building and tracking daily routines.

## Official pages

- [Homepage](https://habittracker.orwich.in/): Product overview, habit tracking guide, app features, and frequently asked questions.
- [Google Play app](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.odinovo.habito): Official Habito Android app listing.
- [Privacy policy](https://habitotracker.com/habito-daily-habit-tracker-privacy-policy): Existing policy link; the original domain may no longer be available.

## About the app

Habito supports daily habit check-ins, user-set goals and schedules, streaks,
reminders, and progress tracking. The app is designed for an offline-first
experience and does not require users to sign in.

The site explains a simple approach to habit tracking: choose a specific
action, set a realistic schedule, record check-ins, and review progress.

## Preferred URL

Use `https://habittracker.orwich.in/` as the canonical homepage.
